dict.string: NotchBuddy switches to the right terminal window and tab (iTerm2, Terminal) when you click an agent session, and controls Spotify and Music right from the island.
NotchBuddy shows your upcoming meetings on the island: how long until they start and a button to join the call. Events are read only on this Mac and are never sent anywhere.
